[P2] Validate the declared type of operation parent IDs

Checking only field presence accepts values such as `parentId: false` or an array, although the published wire schema requires a string or null. If the malformed value is retained consistently in `replay.before`, `replay.after`, and service history, replay validation also passes. Because the CLI does not run the JSON Schema validator, invalid nesting evidence can be reported as conformant. Validate parent-ID types in the history and replay snapshot checks, and add malformed-type regression tests.
